title: PFC Jones at the rotor head
description: A crewman in white T-shirt and cap — Larry believes this is PFC Jones — stands atop a Huey's fuselage working at the main rotor head, cigarette in mouth, silhouetted against a bright cumulus sky. At the far left edge, the tail fin of an adjacent aircraft carries a painted bird-like emblem.
researchNotes: Identification relayed by Larry's son from Larry's dictation (2026-08-15 session; archived as data/recollections/giscus-vn-0012-c18035104.json and -c18035111.json), hedged as belief. Jones recurs: white-T-shirt crewman at the Huey in VN-0020, and possibly the owner of Sarge the monkey ('Jones, the helicopter pilot', VN-0017 comment). The painted tail emblem at frame left remains the strongest physical lead for the unit identification (unresolved question #2). Magnification pass 2026-08-15 (research/magnification/vn-0012-tail-emblem.png): the emblem is now resolved well enough to compare against documented 1964–65 unit tail art. The candidate readings are kept in research/magnification/README.md and are not summarized here while unconfirmed.
